component.name: RookieIDE
component.summary: Lightweight GTK4 and Libadwaita code editor and IDE

description.p: RookieIDE is a lightweight desktop code editor built with GTK 4, Libadwaita, GtkSourceView 5, and VTE. It features multi-tab editing, a file manager sidebar, per-language Compile, Make, and Run commands, theme profiles, bracket autoclose, and snippet autofill.
Initial release with bracket autoclose, snippet autofill, theme profiles, and AppImage support.
